title: Protocol Wizard product library — schema version 1
description: One product and its protocols. The app validates the selection, installed component dependencies, and the merged library before installation.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing to this schema.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS source URL without embedded credentials. The app also validates the parsed URL.

type.description: Free-form source category; common values are shown as examples.

dose.description: A single decimal string value, a minimum/maximum range, options, or null when unknown. These are reference quantities; ranges and component/body-weight doses are not automatically chosen.

suggested_times.description: Local 24-hour times (HH:mm). An empty array leaves times for the user to choose.

weekdays.description: ISO weekday numbers: Monday=1 through Sunday=7.

regimen_type.description: Stacks are viewable reference content; they cannot be activated as a single personal protocol.

regimen.description: Structured reference content. Required core fields are version and phases. Optional metadata fields shown here are retained for display; additional metadata is allowed and does not automatically create a personal schedule.
